title: Wolf Warriors in Sheep’s Clothing: China’s New Subnational Diplomacy in Australia
gist: China's diplomats in Australia have moved from blunt wolf warrior diplomacy to quieter, closed-door subnational diplomacy aimed at local governments and communities, partly to suppress critique hostile to the CCP. The excerpt is a truncated teaser.

insights.claim: China treats diplomacy as an instrument of regime maintenance, including coercive interventions in other states' domestic affairs to suppress conduct or critique hostile to the CCP.
insights.speaker: John Fitzgerald
insights.so_what: Watch Chinese influence operations targeting local governments as a political-risk channel for Australia-exposed assets.

insights.claim: Chinese diplomats in Australia have shifted from the bluster of wolf warrior diplomacy to a quieter, more self-assured subnational approach conducted largely behind closed doors, more evident since Albanese's July 2025 China visit.
insights.speaker: John Fitzgerald
insights.so_what: The thaw in Australia-China ties coincides with less visible, not less intense, pressure on local actors.
